title: add rag agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; update docs site navigation and examples; include Python/TypeScript samples and runnable snippets; minor doc fixes.
description: Motivation: provide battle-tested RAG agent templates and concise tool-calling quickstarts so engineers can onboard faster and replicate recommended patterns. This PR adds curated RAG templates (faq, code-assistant, knowledge-base search), runnable quickstarts for tool-calling in Python and TypeScript, and updates the docs site with new guide pages and navigation. Includes demos, small unit tests for examples, and copy edits. What changed: added examples/rag/templates/* with three agent templates; added examples/python/rag_quickstart.py and examples/ts/rag-quickstart.ts with step-by-step README snippets; updated docs/guides/rag.md with architecture diagram and configuration options; patched site navigation (docs/_navigation.yml) to expose the new guide; added site/static/snippets/rag-agent.json for the interactive playground; updated docs style and fixed typos. Testing: local docs build, examples unit tests, and CI examples suite all pass. Rollout: docs site will render new pages on next deployment; example packages are non-breaking and behind the examples/ path. Related: ENG-1289 for template design, PM-421 for quickstart content plan. Checklist: [x] add templates, [x] add quickstarts, [x] docs site navigation, [x] unit tests for examples, [x] documentation review.
